Subject: Post-call MAP follow-up: supplier enablement & procurement steps for Zenith HealthTech

Hi Tara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I’m attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_draft_v0.1.xlsx) focused on the procurement/vendor onboarding milestone so your finance and procurement teams can see a concrete timeline and responsibilities. High-level recap below: 

MAP milestone: Vendor onboarding / procurement (Ariba)
- Target supplier setup complete: 2026-11-30 (target close)
- Redwood responsibilities: provide vendor forms, signed W-9, banking instructions template, Ariba supplier profile + punchout metadata
- Zenith responsibilities: submit vendor paperwork in Ariba (supplier creation), confirm vendor code, provide banking verification contact and payment terms (net-30 / net-60)
- Dependencies: security questionnaire completion (we already have ACK from your security team on scope), Zenith finance review window, DocuSign for paperwork where required

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm who in your procurement team will submit the vendor profile in Ariba (name & email) and whether you use Coupa for any contracts so we can adapt the MAP.
2) Review the attached vendor_form_zenith.pdf and confirm if your accounts-payable needs additional fields.
3) Once you confirm the Ariba contact, we’ll provide the supplier payload format and an expected 7–10 business day processing estimate after paperwork submission.

I’ve cc’d Rishi (solutions) and Vivek (account lead) — they’ll coordinate the technical/integration items and finance handoffs. If you’re free, suggest a 30-minute follow-up next Thurs (11/4) to walk procurement through the MAP.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_draft_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet), vendor_form_zenith.pdf (fillable), Redwood_W9.pdf (stub)

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear summary and the MAP draft. A few quick clarifications from procurement: 

- We use Ariba for supplier onboarding; Coupa is not used for vendor creation on our side.
- Procurement lead to submit paperwork: Ben Howard <ben.howard@zenith.com> (cc’ing procurement alias).
- Timeline constraint: our Ariba team opens new supplier entries on Tuesdays/Thursdays; 7–10 business days sounds reasonable but depends on banking verification.
- Payment terms: finance prefers net-45, but I will confirm whether we can expedite to net-30 for initial pilots.

Can you send the completed W-9 and a vendor form in the format Ariba requires (we often need a specific vendor code and bank account verification template)? Also, please summarize how Redwood secures banking credentials when we submit them through Ariba.

If you can share the MAP with Ben and procurement, we’ll aim for a follow-up sync next Thursday morning (11/4).

Best,
Tara
Tara Singh

Neha / Vivek —

Quick internal note to confirm feasibility and suggested owner split: 

- Ariba integration: Redwood supports Ariba supplier onboarding. Once Zenith submits the vendor_form_zenith.pdf in Ariba we push the supplier profile and metadata. Typical turnaround: 7–10 business days for a standard supplier (banking verification is the main variable).
- Banking/security: we do not store raw banking credentials in plaintext. If Zenith prefers, we can accept a bank letter or ACH verification through our secure portal and record the masked routing/account on our side; if Ariba enforces bank details in the vendor record, it stays in Ariba and we reference the vendor code.
- Proposed responsibilities (to add to MAP):
  * Redwood: provide signed W-9, vendor_form_zenith.pdf, banking verification template, sample supplier payload for Ariba; stand up a 1-hour onboarding session for Ben + procurement; initial temporary access token for pilot to avoid payment gating.
  * Zenith: submit form and bank verification in Ariba, provide vendor code, confirm payment terms, and confirm AP contact for final invoice routing.

I recommend we keep the MAP target close 2026-11-30 but add a conditional dependency: if we receive paperwork after 2026-11-09, supplier setup will likely slip into December. I’ll draft a short note to include in the MAP spreadsheet under "dependencies / conditional timeline".

Rishi
